title: Files
description: Browse, organize and search Anchoran's own filesystem.

title: Terminal
description: A command-line shell for Anchoran's filesystem and system commands.

title: Settings
description: Appearance, sound, notifications, users, privacy and system info.

title: Notes
description: A simple multi-document text editor.

title: Browser
description: Browse the web from inside Anchoran, on the real Chromium engine.

title: System Monitor
description: Real CPU, memory and platform information.

title: Anchoran Webstore
description: Browse and install Anchoran's applications.

title: Photo Viewer
description: Browse and view images saved in your files.

title: Network Monitor
description: Real connectivity status and latency over time.

title: Event Viewer
description: Anchoran's own real event and error log.

title: Media Player
description: Play audio and video imported into Anchoran.

title: Storage Usage
description: See real free space per drive and what your folders are using.

title: Startup Apps
description: See and remove real Windows programs that launch at sign-in.

title: On-Screen Keyboard
description: Opens Windows' real on-screen keyboard.

title: Narrator
description: Opens Windows' real screen-reading Narrator.

title: Recycle Bin
description: Opens Anchoran's own Trash — restore or permanently delete what you've removed.

title: Windows App Window
description: Runs a real Windows app (.exe) reparented into an Anchoran window, instead of floating separately on the desktop. Experimental — the embedded app always renders on top of other Anchoran windows in the space it occupies, a limitation of mixing a real window with Anchoran's own UI. Purely internal: only ever opened from Files' "Run embedded in Anchoran (experimental)" on a real .exe, never findable as a standalone app on its own.

title: Anchover
description: Shows which build of Anchoran OS is installed — like Windows' own "winver". Not listed anywhere; open it by searching its exact name.

title: Release Ranking
description: Anchoran OS grading its own release history — which version to actually install and stay on, not just the newest one.

title: Plugin
description: Generic window for a downloaded third-party plugin app — see the Anchoran Webstore's Community section.

title: Code Runner
description: Runs a code file with the matching interpreter installed on this PC and shows its output — Files' default for opening code files, instead of opening them for editing.
